cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - SmallPartsTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Tray with slants to easier get out game tokens or screws
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SmallPartsTray --front_panel 0 --outside 0 --sx '30*4' --y 60 --h 25 --angle 60 --Lid_style flat --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes SmallPartsTray --front_panel --outside --sx --y --h --angle --Lid_style --reference --labels
